acceptance: benchbox datagen and ai_primitives work with no qgen/dsqgen present.
Native query generation matches the corpus in BenchBox CI; legacy C path still selectable.
Bundle replay of recorded parameters passes.
description:
docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md decision 8 (query generation in Rust). TPC-H and TPC-DS query managers call the library (native backend) and load lazily so data-only consumers never need a query generator; provenance records the query generator identity and version; published bundles' recorded parameters replay through the library. Delete dead C-tool code (c_tools.py unused parameter computation and global random reseed, DSQGenBinary._clean_sql, the unused qgen compile path in tpch/streams.py, runner.py generate_data_table call) and correct benchbox/_binaries/tpc-ds/NOTICE.txt (Windows binaries are patched). Replace TPC-H DataFrame regex re-derivation of parameters with the library's parameter output.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
